answer_1.quote: We apply model criticism to assess discourse coherence of large LMs... (Section 4) ... we study this through an experiment on generating long‑form documents divided into explicit sections.
answer_1.outputs: Generated articles/sections with latent structures (section types, coreference chains, topic vectors)

answer_2.quote: Both models have strong word‑level perplexity across datasets... Latent PPL tells a different story... The baseline MAUVE ... aligns better with humans than PPLs.

answer_4.quote: Our human evaluation system is based on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Each human annotator first labels the section type of each section ... then labels whether the article is coherent based on the organization of section types.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label section types and decide if the article’s section organization is coherent; they are trained on typical article structures before evaluation.
